comments: Registered as one bank on the stone footing: the pivot x is the centre of the footing, every drawing's bottom edge the foot; one shared scale (the tallest drawing, with its smoke, sets it).

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the palette snap had sent brown-grey flecks (source about 826345) to an olive ink (69793e) and the dark brown outline (source about 231e1c) to a dark green one (182414); the grade maps those two admitted shared inks to the browns 684629 and 25140b; no pixel is moved, added or removed.
geometry: Tiles, footprints and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Seven drawings on a 4x2 grid in reading order = request order: unlit-0, lit-0 .. lit-2, snuffing-0 .. snuffing-2 (the eighth cell is empty). The crops are tight and separated.

pieces.label: unlit-0: cold dark glass and wick, post, ring, cap and stone footing.
pieces.name: unlit-0

pieces.label: lit-0: a tall centred amber flame.
pieces.name: lit-0

pieces.label: snuffing-0: a small side-leaning flame, a thin aqua curl of smoke above the cap.
pieces.name: snuffing-0

pieces.label: snuffing-1: a tiny flame in dark glass, a larger smoke curl.
pieces.name: snuffing-1

pieces.label: snuffing-2: dark glass, the flame gone, a thin aqua wisp.
pieces.name: snuffing-2

size_basis: native canvas 16x34, anchor bottom-centre (8,34); the foot of the post stands on its lamp tile; stage 384x224; a knight is 16x24 in this town.
timing: unlit 12, lit 3 frames of 7, snuffing 3 frames of 6 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox.
